home.faqDefaultSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions about furniture and cashback.

defaultFaqs.question: How does cashback work on this platform?
defaultFaqs.answer: When you shop through our links, you get a portion of the purchase price back as cashback. The exact amount depends on the shop and offer.

defaultFaqs.question: Do I need to register to use discounts?
defaultFaqs.answer: No, you can use most vouchers and offers directly without registering. However, we recommend a free account for personalized recommendations and cashback.

defaultFaqs.question: How long are voucher codes valid?
defaultFaqs.answer: The validity period varies by offer. The expiration date is shown directly on the respective voucher. Expired codes are automatically removed from the system.

defaultFaqs.question: Can I combine multiple discount codes?
defaultFaqs.answer: Usually only one code can be redeemed per order. Whether combinations are possible depends on the shop. Please read the voucher's terms carefully.

defaultFaqs.question: Are new furniture deals added regularly?
defaultFaqs.answer: Yes, we update our offers daily. Subscribe to our newsletter to be the first to know about new discounts and exclusive promotions.

datenschutz.heroSubtitle: NL Furniture – Your trusted partner for furniture comparisons in the Netherlands
datenschutz.intro: At NL Furniture, we value your trust as much as your taste in furniture. This privacy policy explains how we collect, process, and protect your personal data when you use our comparison platform. We act in strict compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR/AVG) and Dutch data protection law.
datenschutz.s1Heading: 1. Our commitment to your digital privacy
datenschutz.s1Text: We process personal data only to the extent necessary and exclusively for the purposes described in this policy. Transparency and data minimization are central to us.
datenschutz.s2Text1: Responsible for data processing on this website is the operator of
datenschutz.s2Text2: If you have questions about data protection or wish to exercise your rights, please contact our privacy team through the official contact channels.
datenschutz.s3Heading: 3. Data collection: how and why we collect information
datenschutz.s3Intro: We collect data in two ways:
datenschutz.s3Item1Text: e.g. when subscribing to the newsletter or contacting us directly (email address, name).
datenschutz.s3Item2Text: When you visit our website, our systems automatically collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, and access time to ensure a stable and secure user experience.
datenschutz.s4Intro: NL Furniture uses cookies – small text files stored on your device – to improve your shopping experience.
datenschutz.s4Item1Text: Required for the website to function (e.g. navigation).
datenschutz.s4Item2Text: Help us understand which furniture categories are popular.
datenschutz.s4Item3Text: Show relevant furnishing ideas based on your interests.
datenschutz.s4Outro: You can manage or decline cookies at any time via our cookie consent manager.
datenschutz.s5Heading: 5. Affiliate tracking: transparency about our partnerships
datenschutz.s5Text: As an affiliate platform, we use special tracking links. When you click on a product, a cookie is set to inform the retailer that you came from NL Furniture. This is used for commission attribution — without us being able to see your personal data (e.g. credit card).
datenschutz.s6Text: When you click "Shop now" or "View offer", you leave our platform. From that point, the respective partner's privacy policy applies. We recommend reviewing it before making a purchase.
datenschutz.s7Text: For optimization, we may use tools such as Google Analytics or Facebook Pixel. These analyze anonymized user behavior. You can disable tracking at any time in the cookie manager.
datenschutz.s8Item1: Right of access: a copy of your stored data
datenschutz.s8Item3: Erasure: deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)
datenschutz.s8Item4: Withdrawal of consent: e.g. newsletter unsubscribe with one click
datenschutz.s8Outro: Contact us at any time to exercise your rights.
datenschutz.s9Text: We use modern SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions. Our systems are protected against common attacks.
datenschutz.s10Text: As we grow or add new partners, we may update this policy. We recommend visiting this page regularly.
datenschutz.summaryText: We protect your data in strict compliance with the GDPR. No direct storage of sensitive purchase data. Affiliate tracking only for commissions (without your personal payment data). Partner shops' own privacy policies apply on their sites. You have full rights (access, deletion, etc.).

springSavecationPage.defaultDescription:
Welcome to our exclusive Special Offers – your best source for top-tier furniture discounts in the Netherlands. Whether you're redecorating your living room, furnishing an elegant bedroom, or modernizing your office – our curated offers give you unbeatable savings from leading furniture brands.

With discounts of up to 70% on selected items from top brands, you have a unique opportunity to acquire high-quality furniture at incredibly low prices. Our voucher codes and special offers are updated daily so you always find the best deals.

springSavecationPage.faq1Q: How do the voucher codes work?
springSavecationPage.faq1A: Click 'Voucher code' on the desired offer. The code is copied automatically. Paste it at checkout with the respective retailer and the discount is deducted immediately.
springSavecationPage.faq2Q: How long are the special offers valid?
springSavecationPage.faq2A: The validity period varies depending on the retailer and promotion. Most offers are available for a limited time – we recommend acting quickly, as popular deals often sell out fast.
springSavecationPage.faq3Q: Can I combine multiple voucher codes?
springSavecationPage.faq3A: In most cases, only one voucher code can be used per order. However, some retailers allow combination with ongoing sale promotions. Check the respective retailer's terms and conditions.
springSavecationPage.faq4Q: Do the discounts apply to all products?
springSavecationPage.faq4A: Most voucher codes apply to selected products or categories. You'll find the exact conditions in the description of the respective offer.
springSavecationPage.faq5Q: How often are new offers added?
springSavecationPage.faq5A: We update our offers daily. Subscribe to our newsletter to be notified immediately when new exclusive deals are available.
springSavecationPage.faq6Q: What should I do if a voucher code doesn't work?
springSavecationPage.faq6A: First check the code's expiration date. If the code still doesn't work, contact us via our feedback form. We'll help you as quickly as possible.
